data.body: PS6: fixed a second real defect LLM-Review surfaced. The library never propagates the applier's CrossProjectTargetError: run_pass_result wraps reconcile_once in 'except Exception' (__main__.py:_reconcile_exception_result -> OPERATIONAL_FAILURE) and _bridge_run re-raises it as rebar.RebarError with message 'ERROR: reconcile_once raised: refusing to apply ... outside the configured scope ...'. So scenarios 6 & 8's pytest.raises(CrossProjectTargetError) would have FAILED the live run. Fix: expect rebar.RebarError with match='outside the configured scope' (asserts fail-closed AND the correct reason). Also pinned scenario 7's two legs from bare Exception to rebar.RebarError. Local ruff/format/mypy clean, 10 collected. All pytest.raises expectations audited: 6/7/8 -> RebarError (library-wrapped), 9 -> StoreIncompatibleError (direct call), 10 -> Exception (direct transport 404).
